object.Title: Entombment of Christ
object.Medium: ink and pigments on thin to medium weight, clean white vellum, well surfaced on both sides, very few hair follicles show; miniatures on heavier parchment
object.Description: For the latest information about this object, Entombment of Christ, visit the Online Collection of the Walters Art Museum.
object.Provenance: Margriete rogm[arie?] ca. 1440-1450; Rev. W. J. Loftie (1839-1911) Collection [Burlington Fine Arts Club Exhibition, catalogue no. 243, 1907-1908]; Acquired by Henry Walters from Leon Gruel, prior to 1931, no. 1164; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
object.MuseumLocation: To learn whether this object is now on view, and in which gallery, visit https://purl.thewalters.org/art/W.165.29V
